CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS sync_article_alias_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF article_id ON sync_article_aliases WHEN OLD.article_id!=NEW.article_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Article alias already bound to another identity'); END
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS sync_article_binding_immutable

CREATE TRIGGER sync_article_binding_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF item_id ON sync_article_ids WHEN OLD.item_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.item_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.item_id!=NEW.item_id AND NOT (
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sync_article_aliases WHERE item_id=OLD.item_id AND article_id=OLD.article_id) AND
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sync_article_aliases al JOIN articles a ON a.id=al.item_id WHERE al.item_id=NEW.item_id AND al.article_id=NEW.article_id AND a.dedup_key=NEW.article_id AND a.link IS NEW.url)
   ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Article id already bound to another item'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS sync_article_insert_binding_immutable BEFORE INSERT ON sync_article_ids WHEN NEW.item_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sync_article_ids WHERE article_id=NEW.article_id AND item_id IS NOT NULL AND item_id!=NEW.item_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Article id already bound to another item'); END

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO sync_book_context VALUES(1,0)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS sync_book_local_chapter_delete BEFORE DELETE ON articles WHEN (SELECT remote FROM sync_book_context WHERE id=1)=0 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO sync_book_events(book_id,chapter_index,changed_at) SELECT book_id,chapter_index,CAST((julianday('now')-2440587.5)*86400000 AS INTEGER) FROM sync_book_aliases WHERE item_id=OLD.id
 ON CONFLICT(book_id,chapter_index) DO UPDATE SET changed_at=max(changed_at,excluded.changed_at);END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS sync_book_local_whole_delete BEFORE DELETE ON channels WHEN (SELECT remote FROM sync_book_context WHERE id=1)=0 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO sync_book_events(book_id,chapter_index,changed_at) SELECT DISTINCT m.book_id,0,CAST((julianday('now')-2440587.5)*86400000 AS INTEGER) FROM sync_book_aliases m JOIN articles a ON a.id=m.item_id WHERE a.channel_id=OLD.id
 ON CONFLICT(book_id,chapter_index) DO UPDATE SET changed_at=max(changed_at,excluded.changed_at);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offline_media_jobs(item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,generation INTEGER NOT NULL,desired TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(desired IN ('download','cleanup')),attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,next_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,last_error TEXT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offline_media_policy(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),suppress_download INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO offline_media_policy(id,suppress_download) VALUES(1,0)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS offline_saved_insert AFTER INSERT ON article_saved_states WHEN NEW.saved=1 BEGIN INSERT INTO offline_media_jobs(item_id,generation,desired,attempts,next_at,last_error)
 SELECT NEW.article_id,1,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM article_saved_states WHERE article_id=NEW.article_id AND saved=1) THEN 'download' ELSE 'cleanup' END,0,0,NULL
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM article_saved_states WHERE article_id=NEW.article_id AND saved=1) OR (SELECT suppress_download FROM offline_media_policy WHERE id=1)=0
 ON CONFLICT(item_id) DO UPDATE SET generation=CASE WHEN offline_media_jobs.desired=excluded.desired THEN generation ELSE generation+1 END,desired=excluded.desired,attempts=0,next_at=0,last_error=NULL; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS offline_saved_update AFTER UPDATE OF saved ON article_saved_states WHEN OLD.saved IS NOT NEW.saved AND (NEW.saved=1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM article_saved_states WHERE article_id=NEW.article_id AND saved=1)) BEGIN INSERT INTO offline_media_jobs(item_id,generation,desired,attempts,next_at,last_error)
 SELECT NEW.article_id,1,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM article_saved_states WHERE article_id=NEW.article_id AND saved=1) THEN 'download' ELSE 'cleanup' END,0,0,NULL
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM article_saved_states WHERE article_id=NEW.article_id AND saved=1) OR (SELECT suppress_download FROM offline_media_policy WHERE id=1)=0
 ON CONFLICT(item_id) DO UPDATE SET generation=CASE WHEN offline_media_jobs.desired=excluded.desired THEN generation ELSE generation+1 END,desired=excluded.desired,attempts=0,next_at=0,last_error=NULL; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS offline_saved_delete AFTER DELETE ON article_saved_states WHEN OLD.saved=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM article_saved_states WHERE article_id=OLD.article_id AND saved=1) BEGIN INSERT INTO offline_media_jobs(item_id,generation,desired,attempts,next_at,last_error)
 SELECT OLD.article_id,1,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM article_saved_states WHERE article_id=OLD.article_id AND saved=1) THEN 'download' ELSE 'cleanup' END,0,0,NULL
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM article_saved_states WHERE article_id=OLD.article_id AND saved=1) OR (SELECT suppress_download FROM offline_media_policy WHERE id=1)=0
 ON CONFLICT(item_id) DO UPDATE SET generation=CASE WHEN offline_media_jobs.desired=excluded.desired THEN generation ELSE generation+1 END,desired=excluded.desired,attempts=0,next_at=0,last_error=NULL; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS offline_article_delete BEFORE DELETE ON articles WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM offline_media WHERE item_id=OLD.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM offline_media_jobs WHERE item_id=OLD.id) BEGIN INSERT INTO offline_media_jobs(item_id,generation,desired,attempts,next_at,last_error) VALUES(OLD.id,1,'cleanup',0,0,NULL) ON CONFLICT(item_id) DO UPDATE SET generation=generation+1,desired='cleanup',attempts=0,next_at=0,last_error=NULL; END
